title: Cleanroom C++17 Reconstruction & Adversarial Verification of libttboringssl.so (Target 41)
acceptance_criteria: Reconstruct > 40 KB of non-stub bilingual EN+VN C++17 source for libttboringssl.so matching AArch64 opcodes and ABI layouts.

Implement TLS 1.2/1.3 client & server handshake state machines, HKDF-Expand-Label traffic secret schedule, QUIC encryption level & transport parameter hooks, ALPN/SNI/ECH negotiation, DTLS timer backoff (60000 ms cap), and SSL_SESSION serialization.
Pass adversary_critic_agent.py (VERIFIED_AND_ACCEPTED), verify_reconstruction_suite.py (100% PASS), and native_audit_watchdog.py (0 high findings).
